name: Bangumi
tagline: Track and discover anime, manga, and games
description:
Bangumi is an unofficial Android app for bangumi.tv, a community site where fans track and rate anime, manga, comics, music, and games. Log what you're watching or reading, rate and review titles, and browse rankings from a large, active community.

It's a full native app built just for the site, so browsing feels quick and smooth on your phone.
